messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a regional traffic steer to shift traffic to EU-edge (target pools) starting 2026-03-18 22:00 UTC. @chris will run the deploy. Short checklist below — please ack and call out blockers.

chris: Ack. I'll be on the deploy window. Can someone confirm the steering policy name and DNS TTL? Need to pre-warm caches.

jia: Policy is 'steer-regional-v3' (already in infra-config repo). TTL we'll use is 60s for the temporary shift, revert to 300s after stable. I added a canary rule for 5% initial traffic.

maria: Plan: steps = 5% -> 15% -> 50% over ~20 minutes. Smoke checks after each step. Rollback immediate to previous policy + cache flush if errors > 1% or latency P95 > 250ms.

andrew: Quick Q: what's the smoke check script? health endpoints + sample prompt to the model? Also who watches live metrics?

chris: Smoke script (run from bastion):
```bash
curl -sS 'https://internal-smoke.redwood/health' || exit 1
# sample generation test
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' | jq .
```
I'll run and paste results during the window. @samir can you own metrics (SLOs/alerts)?

samir: On it. I'll open a short dashboard and watch token_latency_p95, error_rate, and fallback_count. Will post green/red after each step and annotate anomalies.

maria: :thumbsup: DNS pre-prop note: set TTL=60s at 21:45 UTC to avoid long cache tails. @deploy-bot can you schedule TTL change?

deploy-bot: scheduled_change: DNS TTL for *.edge.redwood -> 60s at 2026-03-18T21:45:00Z. job_id=72a9.

chris: I have the rollout script ready. Timeline: 22:00 push policy, wait 5m, run smoke, then proceed increments every 5m. If rollback triggered, I'll revert policy and set TTL back to 300s.

jia: Note: orchestrator fallback mapping updated — if regional pool CPU > 80% we route to 'fallback-small' variant automatically. That setting is active for this steer.

andrew: Code-review ping: left an LGTM on the steer policy PR, small nit about comments only. Not blocking for deploy.

maria: Please reply 'here' if you'll be on call during the window. Also copy any problems to #incidents if we need an accelerated postmortem.

chris: here

samir: here

jia: here

andrew: here

maria: :white_check_mark: Great. Final — if anything odd we rollback and open a post-deploy thread. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/region-steer (bookmark).
